newsitem.title: USA: Holtzman withdraws ONBANCorp sale proposal.
newsitem.headline: Holtzman withdraws ONBANCorp sale proposal.

text.p: Seymour Holtzman, ONBANCorp Inc's largest shareholder, said Tuesday that he will withdraw his proposal to sell or merge the bank.
Holtzman said medical complications from a recent accident had forced him to withdraw his proposal. He said he had planned to make a solicitation at ONBANCorp's 1997 annual stockholders' meeting.
Holtzman owns about 250,000 shares of ONBANCorp or two percent of its total shares and has been seeking a sale or merger of the company for nearly a year.
Last month ONBANCorp began litigation against Holtzman accusing him of agitating for a quick sale and of disseminating misleading information about the company and its directors.
